allowed_scope.purpose: Prove the existing non-interactive lbe CLI is a thin persistent control surface over accepted runtime authorities before R7 installed end-to-end acceptance.
allowed_scope.implementation_changes: Forbidden by default. If acceptance proves a real defect, stop and activate a separate bounded repair slice before changing CLI, runtime, or tests.
allowed_actions: inspect package entrypoint and CLI owner
run repository-owned CLI and related runtime tests
prove session create continue status and inspect across normal CLI invocations
prove provider selection preserves workspace mode and policy identity
prove invalid missing and unknown inputs fail closed
prove session evidence delegates to canonical EvidenceService
prove session validate delegates to the R6F completion runtime using persisted contract and evidence
prove mode commands delegate through GovernedAgentGateway and existing provider controller
run diff scope and clean worktree validation
